products.title: Drift
products.description_html: Fresh, aquatic and woody. Grapefruit, lemon and mint open onto a marine heart of lavender and ginger, settling into guaiac wood, cedar, musk and amber. 50 ml Eau de Parfum.

products.title: Obsidian
products.description_html: Dark, warm, unhurried. Spiced ginger opens onto smoky guaiac wood and a deep, resinous oud. 50 ml Eau de Parfum.

products.title: Velvet Rose
products.description_html: A rose, softened with vanilla. Damask rose and jasmine bloom over vanilla, white musk and amber. 50 ml Eau de Parfum.

products.title: Moonpetal
products.description_html: White flowers by moonlight. Luminous jasmine, brightened with lemon and cool mint, calmed by lavender. 50 ml Eau de Parfum.

products.title: Amber Dusk
products.description_html: The last warm hour of the day. Golden amber and oud wrapped in vanilla, with a spark of ginger and a whisper of rose. 50 ml Eau de Parfum.

products.title: Citrus Mist
products.description_html: Cold citrus, clear skies. Sparkling grapefruit and lemon, cooled with mint and a clean marine accord. 50 ml Eau de Parfum.
